prompt.project_info: Playful winter bikini snow selfie adapted from the supplied prompt and approved-adult identity reference.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult woman with dirty-blonde/light-brown hair in two braided pigtails, fair flushed skin and bright engaged expression, wearing the specified pastel blue-and-white gingham string bikini under a cream chunky-knit half-zip neck warmer with silver zipper and ruffled white edging, plus white faux-fur earmuffs and fur-trimmed snow boots.

prompt.technical_specs: Vertical photorealistic wide-angle smartphone selfie, slight lens distortion, sharp face and clothing detail, realistic snow, knit fibers and wet skin, no readable text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical extreme high-angle winter selfie of a clearly adult woman with dirty-blonde/light-brown hair in two braided pigtails, fair flushed skin and bright engaged eyes, smiling with her tongue playfully sticking out, wearing a pastel blue-and-white gingham string bikini under a cream chunky-knit half-zip neck warmer with silver zipper and ruffled white edging, large white faux-fur earmuffs and fur-trimmed snow boots, one arm extended upward, full body framed against white snow scattered with pine needles and twigs, wooden deck corner at top left, natural overcast daylight with soft snow bounce, cheeky cold-but-fun winter challenge mood, no readable text or logos.
